member.remarks:
If a critical failure is not detected, false is returned and the request is processed.
If a critical failure is detected, true is returned and the request will not be processed.
A critical failure occurs when one of the following conditions is met:
The is null, or is null or whitespace.
The is "disabled".
The is an unrecognized value.

The script parameter string passed with the request.
The current operating mode of the Tingen web service (e.g., "enabled", "disabled", "passthrough").

member.name: T:TingenWebServiceCore.Operation.AvatarField
member.summary: Provides helper operations for inspecting and comparing Avatar field values.

remarks.para: AvatarField centralizes the small, frequently-reused routines that work with individual Avatar fields exposed through a . The helpers normalize comparisons, retrieve field values by identifier, and report whether a field is empty so that calling code does not have to repeat null/whitespace checks or case-sensitivity logic.
Every public entry point emits a trace log entry through so that field-level operations can be correlated with the originating Tingen Web Service session.

member.summary: Determines whether two Avatar string field values are equal using a case-insensitive comparison.
member.param: The first Avatar field value to compare.
The second Avatar field value to compare.
The maximum number of trace log files retained for the active session.
The absolute path to the current Tingen Web Service session folder.
member.returns: true if the two values are equal ignoring case; otherwise, false.

remarks.para: The comparison uses , which matches Avatar's case-insensitive treatment of most character-based field values without incurring the cost of culture-sensitive comparisons.

example.code: bool match = AvatarField.AreEqual("Yes", "yes", traceLogLimit, sessionFolder); // match == true

member.name: T:TingenWebServiceCore.TingenWsvcSession.TngnWsvcSessionError
member.summary: Provides error-handling helpers for an active Tingen Web Service session.

remarks.para: TngnWsvcSessionError centralizes the way unrecoverable ("hard") errors are reported back to Avatar. Routing all hard errors through a single helper guarantees that the running log, the session log, and the response payload returned to the calling Avatar form remain consistent regardless of where the error originated in the request pipeline.

member.name: M:TingenWebServiceCore.TingenWsvcSession.TngnWsvcSessionError.HardError(System.Object,System.Int32,System.String)
member.summary: Records a hard error against the active session and returns it to the Avatar caller.
member.param: The active Tingen Web Service session object that exposes the script parameter and Avatar option object.
The numeric error code that should be sent back to the Avatar form.
The human-readable error message describing what failed.

remarks.para: The error message and the original script parameter are appended to the session's running log via with the "HARD ERROR" category, and then is invoked to deliver the error payload to the Avatar form. This method does not throw; it is intended to be the final step before control returns to Avatar.

example.code: TngnWsvcSessionError.HardError( wsvcSession: tngnWsvcSession, errCode: 3, errMsg: "Unable to resolve the requested Avatar user.");
